correctness.rationale: For f=lambda+a(y)+xb(y) in k[x,y]/(x^2,y^n), (a+xb)^t=a^t+t*x*a^(t-1)*b in any positive characteristic. Over k[y]/(y^n) multiplication on free basis (1,x) is a 2x2 block triangular matrix; Smith valuations of diagonal and offdiagonal terms yield r_t=2n-min(n,d_t)-min(n,2u_t-d_t), including the p|t vanishing term. Second rank differences recover exact Jordan block multiplicities; each alpha,beta valuation cell has size q*w_alpha*w_beta, summing to q^(2n). The alpha=1 top-stratum dichotomy depends on p|n. Independent direct GF(2) multiplication-matrix rank computations exhaust all nilpotent a,b for n=2,3,4 and match every predicted rank and Jordan histogram. This verifies finite examples, not all n and characteristics.

Exact frequencies can support finite-field Artinian classification.

Independent check GF(2), n<=4; full theorem uses Smith normal form proof
